RFC5187-2.2-1.note: Forbidden: a grace-LSA without the Grace Period TLV (Type=1, Length=4), originated or accepted. TestGraceLSARoundTrip asserts the EncodeGraceLSA body length equals period(4)+reason(1)+addr(4) TLVs and round-trips GracePeriod; TestGraceLSADecodeMissingMandatory asserts DecodeGraceLSA rejects a Reason-only body. Neither reads the type octets: encode and decode both use GraceTLVPeriod, so a wrong type number (the TLV absent on the wire as Type 1) stays green. The tagged units are the shared codec; the OSPFv3 origination path (gr_restarter.go, LS type 0x000B) is not driven.

RFC5187-2.2-2.note: Forbidden: a grace-LSA without the Graceful restart reason TLV (Type=2, Length=1). TestGraceLSARoundTrip asserts the encoded body length and round-trips Reason; TestGraceLSADecodeMissingMandatory asserts a Period-only body is rejected. No assertion reads the type octet: both sides use GraceTLVReason, so a wrong type number stays green. The OSPFv3 origination path (gr_restarter.go) is not driven.

RFC5187-3.1-1.note: Re-judged 2026-09-30 (independent judge, c11). Now proven through the real restart path (rfc5187_preserve_restart_test.go): engine A redistributes 2001:db8:5187::/48 (v6InjectExternal), prepareRestart persists into a store; engine B over the same store resumes (inRestart asserted). TestRFC5187LSAIDToPrefixPreservedAcrossRestart +: B maps the prefix to A's LSA ID without redistributing it (only restorePrefixLSIDs can put it there; a no-op capture or restore leaves no entry -> red). - same unit: a prefix first redistributed on B does not take the preserved ID and the preserved prefix keeps its own; an overlay mutants (go test -overlay, tree untouched, scratch/ospf-judge-mut) removing the redistV6Next bump in restorePrefixLSIDs turns it red ('took the preserved LSA ID 1'). Revert records on restorePrefixLSIDs observed red. Old gr_nvs_test.go tags (store round-trip only) remain, unproven.

RFC5187-3.2-1.note: Re-judged 2026-09-30 (independent judge, c11). Positive proven: TestRFC5187InterfaceIDPreservedAcrossRestart +, A holds Interface ID 1041 for gr-test, prepareRestart; B's lsdbTopology announces 1041; an overlay mutants (go test -overlay, tree untouched, scratch/ospf-judge-mut) making restoreInterfaceIDs a no-op turns it red (announces 0). The tagged negative is vacuous: it asserts grInterfaceID(gr-test) differs from the transport index 41, but production grInterfaceID falls back to interfaceIndex(name) (kernel ifindex, 0 for this fake interface), never the transport index; judge probe under the no-op restore mutant: transport=41, resolved=0, so the negative stays green when the ID is NOT preserved. Its recorded red (captureInterfaceIDs) is a panic stub through the shared fixture. Missing: a negative that goes red when a non-preserved ID is used (e.g. compare against what grInterfaceID answers without the preserved map, or assert the Hello/Link-LSA Interface ID is not the fallback), or a {single-polarity} annotation the row does not carry. Old gr_nvs_test.go tags remain, unproven.
